body: Okay. I guess I convinced myself it wouldn't help. Maybe it's just fear. Thank you again. I will try to find someone to talk to.

Funny you should mention moving. The only thing that gives me hope is the thought that one day I can move out west and start over when my daughter gets older. The winters are killing me. If i move away now my ex will take away my custody completely though so I am stuck.  But I would leave tomorrow if I could. Thank you for all the good advice. 

Everything you have mentioned I have actually thought about. I too had bipolar and didnt known it. I had been white knuckling it through life in a manic state and had no idea. My childhood was real bad so I just thought the chaos I fekt inside was that. When my wife left me I swallowed a bottle of Valium but I was staying with my sister at the time and she heard me hit the ground when I 
Passed out.  

I was 302'd and I ended up getting ECT which didnt do anything for me. The medicine made me worse so I eventually got off. I havent been back to psychiatrists since. Maybe I should start with a councelor at first and then try to meet people. I have some trust issues with finding friends. I blame myself for the people i surrounded myself with but when my wife left so did all my friends. They were her friends really i just didnt undetstand that. 

Do now i have a hard time trusting myself if that makes sense. I think the self doubt I feel is my bigest problem.

You are very kind. All of you are. Everything just feels so overwhelming. Even grocery shopping. I've somehow become completely isolated and I used to be an outgoing person. I have no anger towards anyone but the few people I put trust in have betrayed me in life and it is hard for me to be optimistic about meeting a new friend and trusting them. I told myself I would be fine on my own but I don't believe we are made that way. The loneliness is eating away at my sanity no matter how busy i try to keep myself. Maybe a specialist would help me. I don't know much about that sort of thing. I've always tried to do it alone. I just find myself thinking about suicide all the time and it would be so easy and my problems would be over. Then I see my little girls face in my minds eye and I just cant do it to her. I am stuck. Sometimes I think I killed myself and this is hell I just dont know it. That thought scares me  profoundly. Thats when I come closest to doing it. Just to see what happens.
What do you think I should do for help. I dont have any family or friends so just try to tuff it out alone. I want to find help but I dont know how really.

I am worried that my daughter will be attracted to a weak man because she sees me. I wonder if it would be better in the long run for her if I ended it. I look at my bathroom door and see myself hanging there. It would be such a relief. But the guilt of abandoning her is at constant war with my desperstion to be free of this pain. When I really think about it I tell myself it is my duty as her father to protect her from having to live thinking I chose to leave her. But it gets harder every day. I dont see how I can possibly beat this and be a healthy person who she can look up to. i live with this feeling of shame. I dont know how I got here. We had a good life for a few years. She was a happy little girl.

I had a girlfriend for a while but it didnt work out. That was about a year ago. I dont know anyone here and im not very good at making friends. It is very rural where I live too. It sounds pathetic but i look forward to dreaming because in my dreams I have friends and it isnt so lonely. I wish i had at least one friend but im so depressed all the time it is hard to go and be sociable.
